notes: The common Chat ViewModel restores plain composer text per actor and conversation after host recreation. Empty text is not persisted.

Successful send and leaving or deleting the conversation clear that conversation draft. Logout and destructive account lifecycle retire the actor generation. Failed sends preserve the draft and user input wins a delayed restoration.
Generation is part of each storage key. A write from a retired session can delete only its own generation and cannot overwrite a draft saved by the next session, including for the same conversation.

Android uses committed SharedPreferences writes for draft and logout custody, Web enumerates matching localStorage keys and iOS synchronously retires the current NSUserDefaults generation before session teardown.
Attachments, reply/edit context, scroll position and unrelated internal state remain transient. This unit does not claim backend E2E or alter message delivery semantics.
